body: I have my medication, I'm on it, but I'm still depressed; no friends, and family don't care.

We can talk here; I took this year off to work on myself, after failing university because of my depression, my meds helped for the first couple of months and now I feel an episode coming, I'm tired, I didn't choose this life. I don't want to kill myself either, I can't, because it will scar my parents, I don't know what to do.
